entries.0931628d2d484e6d: The company has a structure enabling integrated production from design to manufacturing in Japan and overseas, covering press processing of metal terminals, plating, and resin molding. The fact that the company designs and manufactures its molds in-house and sells precision molds and peripheral equipment along with its products forms a foundation that allows it to serve customers in both mass production of components and molds.
entries.0d9c02218ef3a165: The company has set a long-term management vision for fiscal 2021 through fiscal 2030, “Creating the Future through Mold Technology: Smaller, Faster, and Aiming to Be the Best Partner for Lifestyles and Business through Cutting-Edge Technology”, and is advancing a medium-term management plan that positions the three years from fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2026 as its 2nd STEP. Building on its core mold processing technology and combining new technologies derived from it, the company aims to contribute to the development and advancement of cutting-edge devices and to remain the most trusted business partner.

entries.18d2cc7c770c50eb: Its strength lies in combining a broad range of technologies, including crushing (coining) and drawing and resin molding, with punching and bending, the basics of mold technology, enabling it to meet advanced requirements in all fields. It also achieves processing of components in the smallest class in the world.
entries.244eb446a06ab55d: In the electronic components industry to which the company belongs, medium- to long-term growth is forecast for both lead frames and connector components, against a backdrop of automotive electrification, advances in ADAS technology, and progress in AI technology. By customer location, revenue was largest in Japan at ¥12,664 million, followed by the Philippines at ¥5,885 million and Thailand at ¥4,376 million. Major customers are Nichia Corporation (14.0% of revenue) and Fujikura Conec (THAILAND) LTD. (13.9% of revenue).
entries.249d250aa731798e: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥30,415 million, up 13.1% year on year.

entries.381517c47c77a2ac: Manufacture and sale of lead frames for optoelectronics (opto) and of the precision molds and peripheral equipment used to make them. LED lead frames are components that determine the shape of LED products; the company handles everything from mold design and fabrication through prototype development to mass production. They are used in LED displays, backlights for liquid crystal displays, various automotive lamps, lighting LEDs and others. Major customers include Nichia Corporation. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,190 million.
entries.44448822372252fb: The company is headquartered in Uenohara, Yamanashi Prefecture, and together with four subsidiaries operates four domestic plants and two overseas plants (in the Philippines and China). The number of consolidated employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 1,293.

entries.dafc5455d186d5b2: Manufacture and sale of power semiconductor lead frames and of the precision molds and peripheral equipment used to make them. These are components that hold and fix semiconductor elements and connect them to external wiring; they cover a wide range of uses and specifications, including lead frames for power devices and small-signal devices and heat sinks, and the company consistently mass-produces and supplies them through the metal pressing and caulking processes. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥10,152 million.
